overview.description: The Mast HedgeIndex Corporate Arbitrage ETF (HXA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in multi-strategy alternatives. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to deliver returns through arbitrage and corporate event strategies  including merger arbitrage, volatility arbitrage, and other hedge fund-style approaches  while maintaining low overall volatility and limited correlation to the broader equity market. HXA was launched on Aug 21, 2026 and is issued by Mast.
